task: Build a Python CLI and an offline interactive HTML report from two GPU traces, clock-aligned NVML telemetry, and request records. Compare prefill and decode activity and inspect individual decode rounds.

definitions.weighted_decode_tok_s: Output-token intervals summed over completed requests, divided by total native decode time. Output includes reasoning and tool syntax.
definitions.weighted_fresh_prefill_tok_s: Fresh input tokens divided by the engine counter for active prefill time.
definitions.wall_output_tok_s: All output tokens divided by the recorded session duration, which includes tools and client time.
definitions.completed_model_calls_wall_seconds: Sum of proxy request start to streamed completion intervals for completed model calls.
definitions.cached_share: Cumulative cached input token uses divided by cumulative input tokens across completed requests.
definitions.accepted_share: Accepted draft tokens divided by verified draft tokens across completed requests.
